name: Icebreaker (Apache1999)
tagline: Weekday watch on commercial-property owners showing signs of selling
description: A lead radar for commercial brokers. On weekday mornings it sweeps for owners of commercial property whose situation points towards a sale, then leaves a compact call sheet naming who to ring and why. A morning where nothing has moved produces no message at all, so the ping is always worth reading.
author: Apache1999
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
